run_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI to convert a fine-tuned checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_function: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint by merging backbone and heads config from the starting checkpoint
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_yaml: convert a fine-tuned checkpoint and its YAML config by removing finetune_config and copying backbone from the starting checkpoint
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_data_only: convert a data-only fine-tuned checkpoint by copying both backbone and heads from the starting checkpoint
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_programmati: call convert_fine_tune_checkpoint programmatically with checkpoint paths and optional YAML config paths
